summary: create_app mounts root.router with no auth, then an APIRouter whose dependency is require_gateway_auth. That router includes meta, ready, metrics, config, memory, chat, openai, and admin. Scopes are read, chat, config, and admin. require_scopes treats its arguments as alternatives: the identity must hold at least one.

nodes.role: Accepts Authorization Bearer or X-Api-Key. When identities.auth_enabled(), resolve() must return an identity or the response is 401 gateway_unauthorized. Otherwise a configured GATEWAY_API_KEY is compared with hmac.compare_digest.
No identity and auth on: 401. No identity and auth off: allow. Identity scopes disjoint from the required set: 403 forbidden with required_scope.
GET /health. Scope read. Providers, reliability, prompts, budget, memory, pii, guard.

GET /ready. Scope read. ready requires detected providers and Redis ok. Redis counts as ok when unconfigured, reachable, or configured and READINESS_ALLOW_REDIS_DEGRADED. Otherwise 503 with the same payload in detail.
GET /metrics. Scope read. Prometheus text or 404.
PATCH /config. Scope config. require_configured_gateway_key returns 403 gateway_key_required when auth is off and no legacy key is set.
POST /chat. Scope chat. stream true returns text/event-stream via encode_native.
GET and POST /admin/keys. PATCH and DELETE /admin/keys/{key_id}. Scope admin. Create returns the secret once.

notes: Identity id for a chat command is bound_identity_id(request), not a client-supplied user_id. Memory routes are covered by tests that ignore a client user id.
CORS default origins are http://localhost:3000 and http://127.0.0.1:3000. BoundCORSMiddleware re-reads cors_origin_list from the live runtime settings. allow_credentials is false.
HTTPException handler wraps detail with request_id when the middleware stored one.
Contract paths are asserted by tests/test_route_surface.py.
restart_for advertised by the flag store payload is keys, redis, budgets, MEMORY_EMBEDDER, PII_ENTITIES. Layer toggles themselves are the overlay, not that restart list.
